_help: To add a parish, add it under parishes. To add an event, add it under events: copy an existing event page folder to /parishes/<parish>/events/<event>/, then add a matching entry here. date is YYYY-MM-DD (events drop off the lists the day after). Add "rsvp": true when the page has an RSVP form, so the list button says "Details and RSVP".
